As a kid, I had the same dream almost every single night for what must have been months, it was the strangest thing. I became afraid to go to sleep. The dream itself wasn't too out of the ordinary -- the repetition was the strangest thing about it for me. Every dream would begin with me walking down the hall, approaching my room. I could see my mom in there, with the lights on, ready to read me a bedtime story (I was pretty young at the time). When I crossed the threshold, I suddenly found that it wasn't my room at all, but the study across the hall. The door would close behind me and big, hairy monsters resembling Chewbacca would swarm me and kill me, ending the dream.

The coolest part about the whole thing is how the dreams ended, seemingly for no reason. About a week after they ended, I had a pretty innocuous dream where I was in the hallway again, but it was daytime. My mom was upstairs with me and the vacuum was running downstairs. I asked her if Dad was vacuuming, and she said he wasn't home (I have no siblings). Confused, I looked downstairs to find a Chewie monster vacuuming our foyer, who waved at me cheerfully. Weirdest dream I ever had.
